descriptionChirho: Aramaic verb meaning to complete, finish, or bring to full accomplishment, attested in both Hifil (causative active: 'they completed it') and Pual (passive: 'it was completed') stems, all referring to the completion of the Jerusalem temple rebuilding; glossed as completar/terminar (Spa), पूरी करना/खत्म (Hin), إِكْمال (Arb), 완성하다 (Kor), kukamilisha (Swa). The infinitive, perfect, and conjunctive-perfect forms all express the same core sense of bringing a construction project to its intended end state.
